projects.name: AI-News-Aggregator
projects.purpose: Aggregate AI news and research from multiple sources into local Markdown, then organize, index, search, and explore it through semantic and topic-graph workflows.

projects.name: AutoResearch
projects.purpose: Run a bounded autonomous improvement loop in which Codex edits one scraper, evaluates results, and keeps or discards each change according to an objective score.

projects.name: Daily_Apartment_Pull
projects.purpose: Scrape apartment availability from dynamic sites, validate and normalize listings, persist results to BigQuery, and send scheduled notifications.

projects.name: project-registry
projects.purpose: Provide a private, durable source of truth for project purpose, lifecycle, accomplishments, next actions, and live GitHub attention signals.
projects.desired_outcome: A validated registry covering every owned repository, with evidence-backed pilot briefs and a reproducible dashboard workflow.
projects.next_action: Review and merge the first usable registry, then begin owner review of recently active repositories.
